# Coleo Documentation

> Coleo is a self-hosted control plane for coordinating coding agents through a central Brain, independent Arms, persistent local state, and observable event streams.

## Start Here

- [Getting Started](https://coleo.dev/guides/getting-started): Install Coleo and launch a local control plane.
- [Task Workflow](https://coleo.dev/guides/task-workflow): Create, assign, execute, and inspect agent work.
- [CLI Reference](https://coleo.dev/guides/cli): Use Coleo from the terminal.

## Concepts and Architecture

- [Philosophy](https://coleo.dev/philosophy): Understand the Octopus Model and proposal-based coordination.
- [Architecture Overview](https://coleo.dev/architecture/overview): Trace the major system components and data flow.
- [Harness Contract](https://coleo.dev/architecture/harness-contract): Integrate coding-agent CLI harnesses.
- [Security](https://coleo.dev/architecture/security): Review trust boundaries and deployment controls.

## Deployment

- [Docker](https://coleo.dev/guides/docker): Run Coleo in containers.
- [Coleo Reef](https://coleo.app): Use a managed private Coleo workspace.
